snippet.title: DOG - The dog takes the hindmost! Game for Switch, PS4 & PS5. Official English trailer.
snippet.description: Looks like Ludo, but it's DOG®. In this game, you also have to safely bring your four game pieces into your home area. The difference is that they are moved using cards that have a few surprises in store for you. Team spirit is important, because you can only win together.
